title: CPSLimit
description: CPSLimit A lightweight and high-performance CPS limiter for Paper and Purpur servers. It automatically monitors player clicking speeds and executes configurable kicks to maintain fair gameplay.
body: CPSLimit is a comprehensive and high performance clicking speed enforcement utility specifically engineered for modern Paper and Purpur server environments. This plugin serves as a vital tool for server administrators who wish to maintain a level playing field in competitive game modes like BoxPvP or Skyblock by preventing the use of unfair advantages such as macros or auto clickers. By utilizing a sophisticated sliding window algorithm it monitors both left and right mouse interactions with millisecond precision to ensure that only legitimate clicking speeds are permitted. When the system detects a player exceeding the preconfigured clicking thresholds it instantly triggers an automated kick sequence and shares a customizable notification with the rest of the community. Every aspect of the plugin including limits and messages can be easily managed through a simple configuration file while the lightweight code structure ensures that server performance and tick rates remain completely unaffected even during high player counts.
